title: CaPU v0.28 — Durable Negative Completion Evidence / UNKNOWN Convergence
scope: bounded reduced-width one-command one-DMA-effect durable negative completion evidence and UNKNOWN convergence layered on verified v0.27

workflow.name: CaPU vCML Durable Negative Completion v0.28

verified_invariants: UNKNOWN implies no DMA replay authority, no retirement authority and discriminating evidence required
exact NOT_COMMITTED evidence creates a durable negative receipt and consumes the old issue witness
recovery preserves the durable negative receipt
a matching durable negative receipt dominates a stale UNKNOWN checkpoint and reconstructs NOT_COMMITTED
a new retry consumes the old negative receipt and creates a fresh issue witness returning the effect to UNKNOWN
a current issue witness prevents older negative evidence from describing a newer unresolved attempt
a matching committed completion receipt dominates stale UNKNOWN and keeps replay closed
claim_boundary: bounded reduced-width one-command one-DMA-effect durable negative completion evidence and UNKNOWN convergence; issue/negative/committed receipts are modeled as authoritative durable evidence; no claim about production transport, evidence authenticity or durability implementation, partial/multi-beat DMA, multiple outstanding effects, production widths, or unbounded correctness
